audience: support teams that answer customers in Plain

useCases.title: Triage open urgent threads
useCases.text: List open threads by priority, status or assignee, then read one thread with its customer and labels.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their threads
useCases.text: Find a customer by email address or customer id, then list the threads that belong to that customer.

useCases.title: Add an internal note
useCases.text: Add an internal note to a customer, optionally on one thread. The customer never sees the note.

useCases.title: Assign a thread and set its priority
useCases.text: List the users who can be assigned, then assign a thread to one of them and set its priority.

useCases.title: Label and close a resolved thread
useCases.text: List the label types, add the right labels to a thread, then mark the thread done.
